description: The man wears a long cream tunic with a round dark-and-gold bordered neckline, central gold woven trim and broad decorated cuffs. A dark plum-purple outer robe hangs below the knees with wide gold patterned borders along both front edges and the hem. A purple drape crosses his left shoulder and falls down the left side, edged with gold weaving. A decorated belt with a round purple-stone clasp secures the waist. Dark reddish-brown trousers and dark leather boots show below the layered hem. Both hands are bare, folded loosely at the waist, and his head remains uncovered.
